description: Run a post (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) or email through a synthetic audience and get predicted engagement, sentiment and representative reactions before publishing. Starts the run and waits briefly; collect with aetherya_get_result kind 'post_simulation'. Results are SIMULATED reactions, not real engagement.

accept_sessions.description: Only after a 'needs_price_confirmation' result: the exact requiredSessions value from it, re-sent to authorize the spend. Never guess it.

audience_size.description: Simulated audience members. Default 100. Drives cost.

image_url.description: Public URL of an image attached to the post, if any.

link_url.description: Link attached to the post, if any.

objective.description: What the post is for, e.g. 'drive webinar signups'.

persona_ids.description: Specific personas (from aetherya_list_audiences) to use. Omit to use the workspace pool.

text.description: The post (or email body) exactly as it would be published.

tone.description: Tone of the simulated comments. Default balanced.

name: aetherya_simulate_post
title: Simulate how an audience reacts to a post
